d: Long, flowing chestnut brown hair with straight bangs and a center part frames a youthful face with a cheerful expression and large, sparkling brown eyes. The slender build is dressed in a school-style outfit consisting of a short-sleeved white button-up shirt, a grey pleated mini-skirt, and a grey sleeveless jumper over the shirt, accented by a red scarf draped around the neck. Dark grey stockings are worn on the legs, while the arms are covered by dark grey detached sleeves with brown straps. Massive grey mechanical naval artillery rigs are attached to the back and shoulders.
